basis: Independent visual review of15 supplied yaw0/120/240 1000x1250 WEBP renderings; not an interactive close geometry inspection.

items.assessment: Pass at supplied thumbnail resolution. Face, frontal posture and remaining limbs read clearly. No obvious stray geometry. Existing missing limbs are documented by CMA; back/shoulder openings should not be repaired or assumed to be scan defects.

Pass. Best angle shows face in profile, hand gesture, serpent and tree. Model and decorated base appear intact. Glossy mottled surfaces visible consistently across views; no clear holes, detached fragments or clipping.
Pass. Strongest view shows two faces and conveys all three intertwined figures. Fingers and raised arms remain legible; pedestal is included. No obvious stray gallery geometry or scan breaks.
Pass. Best face view; raised cup and opposite hand remain visible. Bronze is relatively dark but silhouette and drapery are readable. No obvious detached fragments or unintended holes.

Qualified pass. Only supplied frontal view; shows the figure inside drapery. Shape appears intact but interior, facial and fine surface detail is softer than other four models. Thin rectangular museum mounting slab has visibly irregular scan edges; minor mounting artifact rather than sculptural form. Yaw0 and240 show back and are unsuitable as hero.
